description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession module, particularly testing WebSocket interactions with simulated server behavior, device token handling, URL normalization, and timeout logic.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking to simulate WebSocket behavior for testing.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that manages tasks to simulate server interactions.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: An actor used to detect sequence gaps during testing of reconnect scenarios.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSessionTests
classes.description: Test suite for GatewayNodeSession, including connection handling, token management, URL normalization, and event handling.

methods.name: scannedSetupCodePrefersBootstrapAuthOverStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Tests that bootstrap token overrides stored device tokens during setup.

methods.name: bootstrapHelloStoresAdditionalDeviceTokens
methods.description: Ensures additional device tokens received during bootstrap are stored correctly.

methods.name: nonBootstrapHelloStoresPrimaryDeviceTokenButNotAdditionalBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Verifies that non-bootstrap hello messages store only primary device tokens.

methods.name: untrustedBootstrapHelloDoesNotPersistBootstrapHandoffTokens
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap handoff tokens from untrusted sources are not persisted.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlPreservesExplicitSecureCanvasPort
methods.description: Verifies explicit port in secure URL is preserved after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlBackfillsGatewayHostForLoopbackCanvas
methods.description: Ensures that loopback URLs are backfilled with the gateway host.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsUnderlyingResponseBeforeTimeout
methods.description: Tests that invokeWithTimeout returns the response before the timeout if it completes early.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsTimeoutError
methods.description: Verifies that invokeWithTimeout returns a timeout error if the invocation exceeds the specified timeout.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutZeroDisablesTimeout
methods.description: Ensures that a timeout of zero disables the timeout behavior.

methods.name: emitsSyntheticSeqGapAfterReconnectSnapshot
methods.description: Tests that a synthetic sequence gap event is emitted after a reconnect snapshot is received.
